To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a reference based compression algorithm can reduce the size of a target genome by a factor of 4-5 compared to generic compression tools.
We have developed a novel compression technique, which uses a reference genome to compress a target sequence.

(1) a reference based compression algorithm is able to compress a genome to 6.9 MB from 3 GB (Gzip) and 2991 MB (raw); (2) the compression algorithm can be implemented in 200 lines of C++ code; and (3) the compression algorithm runs in 2.7 hours on a standard desktop PC.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of compression techniques for DNA sequences.
the development of compression algorithms for biological data.

developing compression techniques for genomic data that exploit the inherent structure of the data, and we show how the compression of a reference genome can be applied to the compression of a target genome.
